ops.title: Build strict demo and acceptance verifiers
ops.imperative: TDD first: add focused tests and the two strict offline verifier scripts before any demo directory/artifact exists. Prove the exact demo-verifier command refuses missing artifacts. Cover schemas, derived metrics/dispositions, acceptance items, deny receipt, frozen hashes, and archive protection.

preconditions.statement: frozen hashes match, before inventories captured, context and handoff complete

postconditions.statement: tests/verifiers precede demo artifacts and exact missing-artifact command exits 1

constraints: no demo artifacts before verifier RED

ops.title: Generate the offline Epic 418 demonstration
ops.imperative: Generate machine-readable packets, five required Markdown artifacts, and stamped zero-call deny receipt through shipped G1/G2 seams. Derive every comparison metric/disposition from frozen inputs and packets. Run the identical demo-verifier command GREEN plus iterative acceptance verifier.

preconditions.statement: strict verifiers exist and missing-artifact RED captured

postconditions.statement: iterative acceptance verifier passes all ten items

ops.title: Run corpus acceptance and seal evidence
ops.imperative: Run registration rails, installer/corpus validation, full tests, JSON/diff/live-reference/no-network audits, archive before-after comparison, and initial-final dirty preservation. Compute reproducible whole-change ordinal digest/inventory/helper and write G4 IMPLEMENTER_RESULT. Advance then release last.

preconditions.statement: offline demo and both verifiers are green

postconditions.statement: complete G4 result/digest and acceptance evidence ready for independent review

constraints: no push, PR, commit, live issue, network write, or archive rewrite
